intuition: Among projects affordable with current capital, choose the one with the highest profit.

brute_force.approach: For each of up to k rounds, scan all unused projects and pick the most profitable affordable one.

optimal.approach: Sort projects by required capital and push newly affordable profits into a max-heap.
optimal.time: O(n log n + k log n)

edge_cases: No currently affordable project leaves capital unchanged.
Zero-profit projects may be selected without increasing capital.
Stop after k projects or when the profit heap is empty.
